notes: The kept set covers Dicer/miRNA biogenesis and decay (TDMD), cross-kingdom and bacterial small RNAs, snoRNA targeting, m6A deposition/readout/decay plus m1A, ac4C and A-to-I editing, alternative and unproductive splicing (including plant and neuronal microexon cases), circRNA export/translation, lncRNA-protein mechanism (PRC2, NEAT1) and mRNA localization and turnover. It lacks piRNA and germline transposon silencing entirely, has little siRNA/RNAi mechanism outside therapeutics, and still leans toward disease-model m6A, circRNA and lncRNA papers from cancer journals because the citation-ranked shortlist is dominated by them.
